process.1.long: Míeɖoa gbalẽwo ƒe ɖoɖo kple nɔnɔme ƒe nɔnɔmetata gbã. Àkpɔe, eye nàgblɔ wò susu hafi tutuɖo dze egɔme, ale be nu si do ɖa nanɔ te ɖe nusi nèbu ŋu.

process.2.long: Ne wosɔ ɖe tutuɖo la dzi vɔ la, wotua webgbalẽ, app alo dɔ ɖokuiwɔwɔ la. Esɔna kple telefon kple kɔmpiuta, eye àte ŋu agblɔ wò susu esime dɔa le yiyim.

process.2.do.3: Dɔa ƒe yiyi ƒe nyatakaka nana zi geɖe
process.2.you: Ɖo nyaŋɔŋlɔwo, foto kple logowo ɖe klo, eye nàgblɔ wò susu ne èle ele.

process.3.long: Míeɖea nu si do ɖa la ɖe ɖoɖo ɖekae. Nu si mesɔ o la, míeɖɔna, eye emegbe míeda asi ɖe nu sia nu dzi gbugbɔ vaseɖe esime wòawɔ dɔ nyuie le dɔwɔnu vovovowo dzi, eye wòawɔ klo be woaʋu.

process.3.result: Nu si wodo kpɔ eye nèda asi ɖe edzi.
process.4.long: Woɖea nu la ɖa eye wòʋu na ame sia ame. Míeɖoa nu ɖe ɖoɖo ale be Google nakpɔ wò, emegbe míetsɔa mɔ kple mɔfiame nana wò ale be nàkpɔ eŋu dɔ le dzidzɔ me.

faq.title: Biabia siwo dona ɣesiaɣi hafi woadze dɔ ŋu.
faq.description: Ne wò biabia ƒe ŋuɖoɖo meli afi sia o la, aɖaŋuɖoɖo ɖeka ate ŋu akpe ɖe ŋuwò be nàse wò nuhiahiãwo gɔme.
faq.0.question: Dɔ kae Nocoding ate ŋu awɔ?
faq.0.answer: Míetua ame ŋutɔ ƒe portfolio alo CV webgbalẽwo, landing page alo dɔwɔƒe ƒe ɖoɖowo, nyatakaka kple dɔwɔwɔ ƒe sistɛmwo, kple asitsatsadɔ ƒe dɔwɔɖoɖo ɖokuiwɔwɔ.
faq.1.question: Ɣeyiɣi nenie tutuɖoa xɔna?
faq.1.answer: Portfolio, CV alo landing page bɔbɔe xɔa dɔwɔŋkeke 1 va ɖe 3 ne nuwo ɖo klo. Projɛkt gãwo ŋu la, enɔa nusi wohiã, dɔwɔnuwo ƒoƒo ɖekae kple ale si nàgblɔa wò susuwo ŋu.
faq.2.question: Woate ŋu aɖɔ tutuɖo kple dɔwɔnuwo ɖo?
faq.2.answer: Ẽ. Woate ŋu awɔ tutuɖo, gbalẽwo ƒe ɖoɖo, dɔwɔnuwo kple dɔwɔɖoɖo ɖe wò nuhiahiãwo nu. Míekpɔa tutuɖo la ɖekae hafi dɔwɔwɔ nadze egɔme.
faq.3.question: Nu kae le asia me?
faq.3.answer: Asia me tu nu le package kple dɔ si míesɔ ɖe edzi nu. Package Sue me la, kpɔkpɔ kple domain le ƒe 1 me ga manɔ, eye Package Gã me la, kpɔkpɔ kple hosting le ƒe 1 me ga manɔ.

project.category.tiptap: Nuwɔla siwo wɔa nyatakaka ƒe app
project.description.tiptap: Platform si na nyatakaka wɔlawo xɔa nunana tso amesiwo kpɔa wo si le digital ga alo digital nu siwo woƒoa ƒu me, kple nyatakaka le dzɔdzɔme ƒe kpɔkpɔ ɣi.
project.description.senkus: Internet dzi ŋɔŋlɔ si ƒe nyatakaka nye sayans kple alkemi: ŋɔŋlɔlawo ƒoa tsi ƒu, ƒoa digital nuwo ƒu eye wotsɔa wo ɖokuiwo le arena me.
project.description.quickstock: Kɔmpiuta app si kpɔa awu ƒe asitsadɔ ƒe nuwo dzi: ŋlɔ asitsatsa, nu siwo asitsalawo tsɔ vɛ kple nu siwo susɔ ƒe nyatakaka, kple mɔ si wɔ ɖe dɔwɔla sia dɔwɔla ƒe dɔwɔwɔ nu.
project.description.caer: Platform si nana ame be woaɖe digital nuwo ɖe ame, eye woaxɔ wo tso nɔnɔmewo dome, kple IDRX digital rupiah ƒe kpekpe, si hea ga ɣeɖoɖo kple ga xɔxɔ bɔbɔe vɛ.
